blocks.text: This is my Endgame Guide for Ice Shot. The build has amazing clear and very strong boss damage with Snipe, with good gear you're one shotting all bosses. Eventually with enough gear, you can also drop Snipe and become a 1 button mapping and bossing build. Easily the best bow build in 0.5
For the Leveling Guide, check the link below.
Leveling Guide: https://mobalytics.gg/poe-2/builds/ice-shot-deadeye-leveling-guide
Gear Progression:

1) Fully setup non-crit setup
(have heart of the well, cheap for a lot of extra damage/3 prop jewels).
2) Focus on a really good Crit bow and Crit quiver before swapping to crit (or Cadiro's Gambit)
3) Big evasion chest is massive for defense
4) Aim for a 450~ ES helmet when swapping to hybrid
5) After that I would focus on Solid boots/gloves/rings/amulet (+2 proj/spirit on amulet)
6) Get against the darkness with as extra cold (eventually double as extra).

Low priority (too expensive to justify the power they give at the moment, buy if you have currency).
Rakiata's Flow/Garukhan's Resolve/Rite of Passage/Headhunter
These are solid upgrades, but not priority over the above.
This all depends on prices, but I would aim for headhunter first than Garukhan's Resolve
Crafting Guide

Non-crit Bow - ilvl 75: To start off you need a bow with a High %phys (any %phys works, higher is just better). - Can either buy or pickup bases and trans/aug, until you acquire one. With the crafting nerfs, it's pretty RNG to make a really good bow, but you can still craft decent ones. 
The best bases are either Obliterator Bow or Warmonger Bow.
1) After acquiring a high %phys bow(make sure to aug first), use Greater essence of Abrasian. This will give you T3 Flat phys.
2) Use a Sinistral Necromancy and Jawbone to unveil a prefix. Depending on prices, you might want to use a abyssal echoes here. You're looking to unveil any high flat elemental damage (cold is best).
3) Now it's just rng. Depending on how good your bow is and the prices of items, either use Greater or Perfect exalt with "Omen of greater Exaltation". To fill out the last 2 affixes.

Crit Bow - ilvl 75: To start off you need a bow with a High %phys (any %phys works, higher is just better). - Can either buy or pickup bases and trans/aug, until you acquire one. With the crafting nerfs, it's pretty RNG to make a really good bow, but you can still craft decent ones. 
The best bases are either Obliterator Bow or Warmonger Bow.
1) After acquiring a high %phys bow(make sure to aug first), use Greater essence of seeking. This will give you T3 Crit.
2) Use a Sinistral Necromancy and Jawbone to unveil a prefix. Depending on prices, you might want to use a abyssal echoes here (ancient jawbone is also cheap early league). You're looking to unveil high flat physical damage, but any high tier elemental flat would also be fine.
3) Now it's just rng. Depending on how good your bow is and the prices of items, either use Greater or Perfect exalt with "Omen of greater Exaltation". To fill out the last 2 affixes.

Quiver - ilvl 75: The quiver craft is mostly RNG but there's some steps you can take to improve your odds of success, just keep in mind most crafts will end up being mediocre when it comes to the quiver.
1) Perfect trans/aug quiver until 2 good affixes(can also greater) (flat dmg or inc bow dmg on prefix and +1, crit or atk speed on suffix).
2) Perfect regal and hope for a 3rd good affix (suffix is the ideal scenario here).
3) If it hit a bad affix, you can use a greater chaos orb and try to replace the bad affix, 2/3 to brick here.
4) Dextral necromancy + jawbone on the quiver, if it's 3 gg mods you should use an abyssal echoes
5) If you hit a good suffix, you should consider using perfect exalt+double exalt omen to finish the craft
This is the cheapest way to make a GG quiver, lots of rng steps but eventually you will hit. More expensive methods will require omen of lights, fracture and/or whittles.
Quiver - ilvl75: More expensive method
If you hit +2 lvls/crit on the suffix with t1 Flat on the prefix, you can jawbone the suffix and go for a 1/3 fracture (if you miss the fracture it's fine, just do the same steps as above) - If you fracture flat dmg, you can exalt 1 mod on the prefix and than use Essence of hysteria + essence of sinistral crystal to have 100% chance of adding bow dmg onto your prefix. The last prefix you will slam with a perfect exalt and hope to not hit accuracy. If the quiver is 5 GG mods, than you should echoes/omen of light your last suffix until you hit crit or attack speed.

Amulet - Ilvl 80 or ilvl 82 (82 is t1 resist) - The amulet craft is mostly deterministic, but expensive. You'll only need 1 fracture base to finish the craft.
1) Fracture or buy a +3 projectile amulet
2) annul down to 2 modifiers (fracture mod+random mod)
3) Chaos spam until t1 or t2 spirit
4) Add 1 suffix with dextral exaltation and 1 exalt
5) Use "dextral crystallisation" with "essence of enhancement" 
6) Use your desired element catalyst (tul, xoph or esh) until the amulet is 20% quality.
7) Perfect exalt with "dextral exaltation" and "Catalysing Exaltation" - High chance to hit a resist.
8) If you hit a resist, repeat the same step above (can use the same catalyst because the amulet can still hit all resist). 
If the amulet didn't hit resist or a good stat (crit/rarity are good). Than you either need to annul or collarbone + dextral necromance + omen of light to remove the mod and go again.
9) collarbone + abyssal echoes + omen of light until you get your last desired prefix.

Helmet - ilvl 78 - Cheap method
1) Buy or perfect trans/aug bases until you hit t1 +energy shield
2) Use "greater essence of enhancement"
3) Use "sinistral necromancy" with a preserved rib
4) Unveil and take any hybrid %es
5) If the hybrid % was t1 I would use a perfect exalt + greater exaltation, otherwise just use a greater exalt to finish the suffixes. 
6) If the suffixes/prefixes are really good I would finish with vaal infusers (has a chance to corrupt but the item cannot brick, just make sure to add a socket before using this).

Helmet - ilvl 78 - Cheap but random (this method allows the chance for triple t1 prefix).
1) Buy or perfect trans/aug bases until you hit t1 %energy shield or +energy shield.
2) If the prefix/suffix is good (good suffix is resist/crit/rarity) I would use a resist or rarity essence.
3) sinistral necromancy + preserved rib and than greater exalt + greater exaltation omen
4) If you hit a good hybrid prefix tier (t3/t2/t1) I would use an abyssal echoes and hope you hit a good tier.
5) Finish with vaal infusers if the item has high tier prefixes.

Emerald Jewels - (expensive).
Step 1: Buy or fracture Critical damage bonus for attacks (you want 20%)
Step 2: Chaos spam for increased critical hit chance
Step 3: Make sure you have a 4 mod jewel, now use "potent liquid contempt". If you lose your crit Suffix, go back to step 2.
Step 4: Use preserved cranium with abyssal echoes and omens of lights until you unveil attack speed 
Step 5: Once you got your desired mod, you now now need to annul the prefix with a "sinistral annulment" (if you miss the +1 suffix, you'll have to do this twice).
Step 6: Once the +1 suffix crafted mod is removed, you'll now want to exalt slam until 5 affixes
Step 7: chaos spam for 1 good prefix (proj damage, elemental damage, dmg vs rares, attack damage).
Final step 8: Use potent liquid of ferocity. 50/50% chance to finish. If you lose your good modifier, go back to step 7.

blocks.text: Entering maps/early progression. This gear should be easily acquirable with pure SSF gameplay or very little trading. This is a non-crit and pure life/evasion setup.

Mandatory Stats: Make sure to fill out your resist, you want 75% fire/cold/lightning resist. Chaos resist is good, but not mandatory to have 75%, I usually aim for 30-50%. You'll also most likely need 1-2 attribute rolls on gear, belt will solve strength and if you need intelligence, get it on a ring or amulet.
Rings/glove: try to focus on high flat damage to attacks, preferable cold/phys.

Bow: You want the highest dps ele/phys weapon you can afford. Obliterator Bow is usually the go to, as it has very high base damage and the downside is negligible.  Check the notes at the bottom of the guide to learn how to craft a bow. Before you have access to Obliterator Bow, just use the highest DPS bow you find on the ground or can trade for.
Greater Iron Rune will provide the highest dps.
Quiver: Just good dps stats, high flat/bow dmg or projectile speed with attack speed. Ideally just aim for 3-4 stats from the quiver I'm showing in the gear preview.

amulet: Preferable want +proj levels. Crit chance/crit damage is also good, once you swap to crit. Attributes/resist are also fine here. You need at least 30 spirit on the amulet to use all spirit gems.
Helmet: At the start just look for a high life/evasion/resist helmet, eventually we'll swap to a pure ES helmet with Subterfuge Mask, but you probably wont have a good one for early mapping.
Chest: you want the highest evasion chest you can afford, this is very important for defense, specially when combined with Beastial Skin on the passive tree. use Greater Iron Rune
Boots: You want the highest movement speed boots you can afford, it's a very important stat. Besides that look for high life/resistance.
Belt: Not a lot of choices here, just Life/str/resist, eventually you want to get a Headhunter.
Rarity is still really good in 0.5, I would try to hit at least 100% if you want to farm efficiently (don't focus on this if you feel like you're lacking damage or defense)

Jewels on tree: Just looking for generic damage: attack damage, elemental damage, movement speed, bonus from quivers, projectile damage, attack speed, crit chance, crit damage, etc.
Eventually you'll also want Heart of the Well with double "gain as extra" and Against the Darkness with double again as extra as well.

important:
You'll want 1 sapphire jewel with mana on kill to sustain mana during mapping. For bosses, having Mark of Siphoning II on Freezing Mark with Eternal Mark should give you enough sustain.

Anoint:
Damage: Serrated Edges
This is just a cheap anoint and pretty effective when you eventually swap to crit.
The links are in priority, so takeout the the last gem if you don't have a 6 link in that skill.

6 Link Priority: Snipe -> Ice Shot -> Herald of Ice -> Freezing Mark
Quality Priority:  Freezing Mark -> Herald of Ice -> Snipe -> Ice Shot
Don't use Elemental Armament III, only level 2.
If you don't have the spirit or want to drop it, the spirit Mirage Archer can be dropped for Wind Dancer(link with Blind II and Knockback).

Early mapping gameplay:
You want to keep the buff from Freezing Mark up, has a 20 second duration. Besides that you're just using Ice shot, Snipe is only for map bosses. Optional: use Ice-Tipped Arrows

Boss rotation:
The goal is to freeze the boss into a Barrage Snipe combo.
Pre-place Tornado Shot, cast Ice-Tipped Arrows, spam Ice Shot until the boss is frozen. Use Barrage into Snipe. Make sure you still have a Tornado Shot down before casting barrage/snipe.

Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and Freezing Mark on weapon set 2.

Take whatever attribute you need at the time, you'll default to dex if you don't need anything. You should also lookout for good attribute amulets or a strength belt to help out with requirements later on.

This is a level 75 tree, while you should be entering maps around lvl 60-65, just fill out the nodes as you go. If you need defense start taking the evasion/deflection nodes, otherwise just keep clicking the damage nodes.
If you have projectile speed on your quiver, you should also take Feathered Fletching

Ascendancy order:
Projectile Proximity Specialisation(point blank) -> Endless Munitions -> Gathering Winds -> Mirage Deadeye

blocks.text: Midgame setup that should be able to do the quest version of all pinnacle bosses.This gear should be easily acquirable with pure SSF gameplay or very little trading. This is a non-crit and pure life/evasion setup.

Mandatory Stats: Make sure to fill out your resist, you want 75% fire/cold/lightning resist. Chaos resist is good, but not mandatory to have 75%, I usually aim for 30-50%. You'll also most likely need 1-2 attribute rolls on gear, belt will solve strength and if you need intelligence, get it on a ring or amulet.
Rings/glove: try to focus on high flat damage to attacks, preferable cold/phys.

Bow: You want the highest dps ele/phys weapon you can afford. Obliterator Bow is usually the go to, as it has very high base damage and the downside is negligible.  Check the notes at the bottom of the guide to learn how to craft a bow.
Greater Iron Rune will provide the highest dps.
Quiver: Just good dps stats, high flat/bow dmg or projectile speed with attack speed. Ideally just aim for 3-4 stats from the quiver I'm showing in the gear preview.

amulet: Preferable want +proj levels. Crit chance/crit damage is also good, once you swap to crit. Attributes/resist are also fine here. You need at least 30 spirit on the amulet to use all spirit gems.
Helmet: At the start just look for a high life/evasion/resist helmet, eventually we'll swap to a pure ES helmet with Subterfuge Mask, but you probably wont have a good one for early mapping.
Chest: you want the highest evasion chest you can afford, this is very important for defense, specially when combined with Beastial Skin on the passive tree. use Greater Iron Rune
Boots: You want the highest movement speed boots you can afford, it's a very important stat. Besides that look for high life/resistance.
Belt: Not a lot of choices here, just Life/str/resist, eventually you want to get a Headhunter.
Rarity is still really good in 0.5, I would try to hit at least 100% if you want to farm efficiently (don't focus on this if you feel like you're lacking damage or defense)

Jewels on tree: Just looking for generic damage: attack damage, elemental damage, movement speed, bonus from quivers, projectile damage, attack speed, crit chance, crit damage, etc.
Eventually you'll also want Heart of the Well with double "gain as extra" and Against the Darkness with double again as extra as well.

important:
You'll want 1 sapphire jewel with mana on kill to sustain mana during mapping. For bosses, having Mark of Siphoning II on Freezing Mark with Eternal Mark should give you enough sustain.

Anoint:
Damage: Serrated Edges
This is just a cheap anoint and pretty effective when you eventually swap to crit.

---Mana Issues
There's a few things you can do here to help out your mana sustain and I'll list them all here.
Reminder: Always run one jewel with 2% mana on kill.

1) Run a regular mana flask with increased recovery and just use your mana flask button, this along with a 2% mana on kill jewel will easily sustain you
2) Take Conservative Casting for 3 passiv points.
3) Drop Wind Dancer for Mana Remnants (use Harmonic Remnants II, Remnant Potency III and Khatal's Rejuvenation - For khatal you either need Dialla's Desire as well or 1 point into herald reservation
The links are in priority, so takeout the the last gem if you don't have a 6 link in that skill.

6 Link Priority: Snipe -> Ice Shot -> Herald of Ice 
Quality Priority:  Freezing Mark -> Herald of Ice -> Snipe -> Ice Shot
Keep in mind you don't need Fork on Ice Shot when doing pinnacle bosses, a good swap is Freeze.
Don't use Elemental Armament III, only level 2.
If you don't have the spirit or want to drop it, the spirit Mirage Archer can be dropped for Wind Dancer(link with Blind II and Knockback).

Early mapping gameplay:
You want to keep the buff from Freezing Mark up, has a 20 second duration. Besides that you're just using Ice shot, Snipe is only for map bosses. Optional: use Ice-Tipped Arrows

Boss rotation:
The goal is to freeze the boss into a Barrage Snipe combo.
Pre-place Tornado Shot, cast Ice-Tipped Arrows, spam Ice Shot until the boss is frozen. Use Barrage into Snipe. Make sure you still have a Tornado Shot down before casting barrage/snipe.

Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and Freezing Mark on weapon set 2.
Take whatever attribute you need at the time, you'll default to dex if you don't need anything, after 161 dex you should default to strength for more HP.
This is a level 90 tree. If you need defense start taking the evasion/deflection nodes, otherwise just keep clicking the damage nodes.
If you have projectile speed on your quiver, you should also take Feathered Fletching

Ascendancy order:
Projectile Proximity Specialisation(point blank) -> Endless Munitions -> Gathering Winds -> Mirage Deadeye

blocks.text: Swapping over to hybrid, you can also go for crit before hybrid but it tends to be more expensive. Going evasion/energy shield will more than double your max hit.

Mandatory Stats: Make sure to fill out your resist, you want 75% fire/cold/lightning resist. Chaos resist is good, but not mandatory to have 75%, I usually aim for 30-50%. You'll also most likely need 1-2 attribute rolls on gear, belt will solve strength and if you need intelligence, get it on a ring or amulet.

Hybrid swap: You want the highest Energy shield helmet you can afford and a very high evasion chest to make Ghost Dance effective, as it's your only way to recover ES. I would also try to get good hybrid boots. You'll probably need intelligence on helmet to have enough attributes.
Rings/glove: try to focus on high flat damage to attacks, preferable cold/phys.

Bow: You want the highest dps ele/phys weapon you can afford. Obliterator Bow is usually the go to, as it has very high base damage and the downside is negligible.  Check the notes at the bottom of the guide to learn how to craft a bow.
Greater Iron Rune will provide the highest dps.
Quiver: Just good dps stats, high flat/bow dmg or projectile speed with attack speed. Ideally just aim for 3-4 stats from the quiver I'm showing in the gear preview.

amulet: Preferable want +proj levels. Crit chance/crit damage is also good, once you swap to crit. Attributes/resist are also fine here. You need at least 30 spirit on the amulet to use all spirit gems.
Helmet: At the start just look for a high life/evasion/resist helmet, eventually we'll swap to a pure ES helmet with Subterfuge Mask, but you probably wont have a good one for early mapping.
Chest: you want the highest evasion chest you can afford, this is very important for defense, specially when combined with Beastial Skin on the passive tree. use Greater Iron Rune
Boots: You want the highest movement speed boots you can afford, it's a very important stat. Besides that look for high life/resistance.
Belt: Not a lot of choices here, just Life/str/resist, eventually you want to get a Headhunter.
Rarity is still really good in 0.5, I would try to hit at least 100% if you want to farm efficiently (don't focus on this if you feel like you're lacking damage or defense)

Jewels on tree: Just looking for generic damage: attack damage, elemental damage, movement speed, bonus from quivers, projectile damage, attack speed, crit chance, crit damage, etc.
Eventually you'll also want Heart of the Well with double "gain as extra" and Against the Darkness with double again as extra as well.

important:
You'll want 1 sapphire jewel with mana on kill to sustain mana during mapping. For bosses, having Mark of Siphoning II on Freezing Mark with Eternal Mark should give you enough sustain.

Anoint:
Damage: Serrated Edges
This is just a cheap anoint and pretty effective when you eventually swap to crit.

---Mana Issues
There's a few things you can do here to help out your mana sustain and I'll list them all here.
Reminder: Always run one jewel with 2% mana on kill.

1) Run a regular mana flask with increased recovery and just use your mana flask button, this along with a 2% mana on kill jewel will easily sustain you
2) Take Conservative Casting for 3 passive points.
3) Drop Wind Dancer for Mana Remnants (use Harmonic Remnants II, Remnant Potency III and Khatal's Rejuvenation - For khatal you either need Dialla's Desire as well or 1 point into herald reservation
The links are in priority, so takeout the the last gem if you don't have a 6 link in that skill.

6 Link Priority: Snipe -> Ice Shot -> Herald of Ice 
Quality Priority:  Freezing Mark -> Herald of Ice -> Snipe -> Ice Shot
Keep in mind you don't need Fork on Ice Shot when doing pinnacle bosses, a good swap is Freeze.
Don't use Elemental Armament III, only level 2.

We're tight on skill slots here and there are a few options you can do. Ice-Tipped Arrows arrows can be dropped for another spirit gem if you have 150 spirit, either Wind Dancer for defense or Combat Frenzy for extra frenzy charges (1 frenzy is roughly 20% more damage for snipe and you wont get more than 1 on pinnacle bosses, once you have enough gear the frenzys aren't needed which is why I dropped it at this point).
You can also drop Mirage Archer for one of these if you don't like it.
Ghost Dance needs 20% quality

Early mapping gameplay:
You want to keep the buff from Freezing Mark up, has a 20 second duration. Besides that you're just using Ice shot, Snipe is only for map bosses. Optional: use Ice-Tipped Arrows

Boss rotation:
The goal is to freeze the boss into a Barrage Snipe combo.
Pre-place Tornado Shot, cast Ice-Tipped Arrows, spam Ice Shot until the boss is frozen. Use Barrage into Snipe. Make sure you still have a Tornado Shot down before casting barrage/snipe.

Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and Freezing Mark on weapon set 2.
Take whatever attribute you need at the time, you'll default to dex if you don't need anything, after 161 dex you should default to strength for more HP.
This is a level 95 tree. Takeout some hybrid nodes if you're lower lvl.
If you have projectile speed on your quiver, you should also take Feathered Fletching

Ascendancy order:
Projectile Proximity Specialisation(point blank) -> Endless Munitions -> Gathering Winds -> Mirage Deadeye

blocks.text: Crit is the best way to scale your endgame damage, although with the crafting nerfs it will be more expensive to go crit. The non-crit version should be able to do every boss in the game.

Mandatory Stats: Make sure to fill out your resist, you want 75% fire/cold/lightning resist. Chaos resist is good, but not mandatory to have 75%, I usually aim for 30-50%. You'll also most likely need 1-2 attribute rolls on gear, belt will solve strength and if you need intelligence, get it on a ring or amulet.

Hybrid swap: You want the highest Energy shield helmet you can afford and a very high evasion chest to make Ghost Dance effective, as it's your only way to recover ES. I would also try to get good hybrid boots. You'll probably need intelligence on helmet to have enough attributes.
Rings/glove: try to focus on high flat damage to attacks, preferable cold/phys.
Bow: When swapping to crit, you want a high crit bow, preferable with t3 %crit or higher. (3% or more). After that, get the highest dps you can afford or craft.

Quiver: You preferable want a crit quiver on the Visceral Quiver base. You'll want both crit hit chance and crit damage. Good prefixes are bow damage/proj speed/cold damage to attack/phys damage to attacks. Cadiro's Gambit is also a really good quiver and highly worth getting once you can afford it (I would only use this quiver if you're crit).

amulet: Preferable want +proj levels. Crit chance/crit damage is also good, once you swap to crit. Attributes/resist are also fine here. You need at least 45 spirit on the amulet to use all spirit gems. Crit on amulet is also strong, but might be expensive with spirit and +3 proj.
Helmet: It's very important to have a high ES helmet because of Subterfuge Mask.
Chest: you want the highest evasion chest you can afford, this is very important for defense, specially when combined with Beastial Skin on the passive tree. use Greater Iron Rune
Boots: You want the highest movement speed boots you can afford, it's a very important stat. Besides that look for high life/resistance.
Belt: Not a lot of choices here, just Life/str/resist, eventually you want to get a Headhunter.
Rarity: Still really good in 0.5, I would try to hit at least 100% if you want to farm efficiently (don't focus on this if you feel like you're lacking damage or defense)

Jewels on tree: Just looking for generic damage: attack damage, elemental damage, movement speed, bonus from quivers, projectile damage, attack speed, crit chance, crit damage, etc.
Eventually you'll also want Heart of the Well with double "gain as extra" and Against the Darkness with double again as extra as well.

important:
You'll want 1 sapphire jewel with mana on kill to sustain mana during mapping. For bosses, having Mark of Siphoning II on Freezing Mark with Eternal Mark should give you enough sustain.

Anoint: Climate Change or  Beastial Skin for defense
Serrated Edges is always a cheap option.

---Mana Issues
There's a few things you can do here to help out your mana sustain and I'll list them all here.
Reminder: Always run one jewel with 2% mana on kill.

1) Run a regular mana flask with increased recovery and just use your mana flask button, this along with a 2% mana on kill jewel will easily sustain you
2) Take Conservative Casting for 3 passives points.
3) Drop Wind Dancer for Mana Remnants (use Harmonic Remnants II, Remnant Potency III and Khatal's Rejuvenation - For khatal you either need Dialla's Desire as well or 1 point into herald reservation
The links are in priority, so takeout the the last gem if you don't have a 6 link in that skill.

6 Link Priority: Snipe -> Ice Shot -> Herald of Ice 
Quality Priority:  Freezing Mark -> Herald of Ice -> Snipe -> Ice Shot
Keep in mind you don't need Fork on Ice Shot when doing pinnacle bosses, a good swap is Cold Attunement or Freeze.
Don't use Elemental Armament III, only level 2.

You want 145 spirit to run all spirit gems (ghost dance is 25 spirit at 20% quality).
To run Khatal's Rejuvenation You need Dialla's Desire(if you don't have, than drop Khatal's).
Ghost Dance needs 20% quality

On pinnacle bosses swap your Rakiata's Flow into Snipe (drop Elemental Armament II)
Garukhan's Resolve is also very strong, if you have it replace Inexorable Critical I on Snipe.
If your character is geared, you can also just spam Ice Shot on bosses and instantly kill them without snipe, just make sure to keep your Tornado Shot up.

Boss rotation:
The goal is to freeze the boss into a Barrage Snipe combo.
Pre-place Tornado Shot, spam Ice Shot until the boss is frozen. Use Barrage into Snipe. Make sure you still have a Tornado Shot down before casting barrage/snipe.

Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and Freezing Mark on weapon set 2.
Take whatever attribute you need at the time, you'll default to dex if you don't need anything, after 161 dex you should default to strength for more HP.
Once you have Rakiata's Flow you can takeout Snowpiercer and instead take Beastial Skin for more defense.
This is a level 94 tree. Takeout some Evasion/energy shield hybrid nodes if you're lower lvl.
If you have projectile speed on your quiver, you should also take Feathered Fletching
Beastial Skin is a very solid evasion node if you want higher evasion (can also anoint this).

Ascendancy order:
Projectile Proximity Specialisation(point blank) -> Endless Munitions -> Gathering Winds -> Mirage Deadeye

blocks.text: this is the uber endgame version. Very expensive with aspirational gear.

Mandatory Stats: Make sure to fill out your resist, you want 75% fire/cold/lightning resist. Chaos resist is good, but not mandatory to have 75%, I usually aim for 30-50%. You'll also most likely need 1-2 attribute rolls on gear, belt will solve strength and if you need intelligence, get it on a ring or amulet.

Hybrid swap: You want the highest Energy shield helmet you can afford and a very high evasion chest to make Ghost Dance effective, as it's your only way to recover ES. I would also try to get good hybrid boots. You'll probably need intelligence on helmet to have enough attributes.
Rings/glove: try to focus on high flat damage to attacks, preferable cold/phys.
Bow: When swapping to crit, you want a high crit bow, preferable with t3 %crit or higher. (3% or more). After that, get the highest dps you can afford or craft.

Quiver: You preferable want a crit quiver on the Visceral Quiver base. You'll want both crit hit chance and crit damage. Good prefixes are bow damage/proj speed/cold damage to attack/phys damage to attacks. Cadiro's Gambit is also a really good quiver and highly worth getting once you can afford it (I would only use this quiver if you're crit).

amulet: Preferable want +proj levels. Crit chance/crit damage is also good, once you swap to crit. Attributes/resist are also fine here. You need at least 45 spirit on the amulet to use all spirit gems. Crit on amulet is also strong, but might be expensive with spirit and +3 proj.
Helmet: It's very important to have a high ES helmet because of Subterfuge Mask.
Chest: you want the highest evasion chest you can afford, this is very important for defense, specially when combined with Beastial Skin on the passive tree. use Greater Iron Rune
Boots: You want the highest movement speed boots you can afford, it's a very important stat. Besides that look for high life/resistance.
Belt: Headhunter is the best choice if you're doing high juice maps, the new Mageblood is also a good option if you're doing strats without a lot of rares. (quicksilver/silver/jade)
Rarity: Still really good in 0.5, I would try to hit at least 100% if you want to farm efficiently (don't focus on this if you feel like you're lacking damage or defense)

Jewels on tree: Just looking for generic damage: attack damage, elemental damage, movement speed, bonus from quivers, projectile damage, attack speed, crit chance, crit damage, etc.
Eventually you'll also want Heart of the Well with double "gain as extra" and Against the Darkness with double again as extra as well.
Rite of Passage: Cat aspect is the best, but Stag and wolf are also good.

important:
You'll want 1 sapphire jewel with mana on kill to sustain mana during mapping. For bosses, having Mark of Siphoning II on Freezing Mark with Eternal Mark should give you enough sustain.

Anoint: Serrated Edges or  Beastial Skin for defense
Helm Anoint: Thin Ice

---Mana Issues
There's a few things you can do here to help out your mana sustain and I'll list them all here.
Reminder: Always run one jewel with 2% mana on kill.

1) Run a regular mana flask with increased recovery and just use your mana flask button, this along with a 2% mana on kill jewel will easily sustain you
2) Take Conservative Casting for 3 passives points.
3) Drop Wind Dancer for Mana Remnants (use Harmonic Remnants II, Remnant Potency III and Khatal's Rejuvenation - For khatal you either need Dialla's Desire as well or 1 point into herald reservation

You want 147 spirit to run all spirit gems (ghost dance is 25 spirit at 20% quality).
To run Wind Dancer you need Atziri's Communion
To run Khatal's Rejuvenation You need Dialla's Desire(if you don't have, than drop Khatal's).

On pinnacle bosses swap your Rakiata's Flow into Snipe (drop Elemental Armament II)
Garukhan's Resolve is also very strong, if you have it replace Inexorable Critical I on Snipe.
If your character is geared, you can also just spam Ice Shot on bosses and instantly kill them without snipe, just make sure to keep your Tornado Shot up.

Boss rotation:
The goal is to freeze the boss into a Barrage Snipe combo.
Pre-place Tornado Shot, spam Ice Shot until the boss is frozen. Use Barrage into Snipe. Make sure you still have a Tornado Shot down before casting barrage/snipe.

Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and Freezing Mark on weapon set 2.
Take whatever attribute you need at the time, you'll default to dex if you don't need anything, after 161 dex you should default to strength for more HP.
Once you have Rakiata's Flow you can takeout Snowpiercer and instead take Beastial Skin for more defense.
This is a level 96 tree. Takeout some Evasion/energy shield hybrid nodes if you're lower lvl.
If you have projectile speed on your quiver, you should also take Feathered Fletching
Beastial Skin is a very solid evasion node if you want higher evasion (can also anoint this).

Ascendancy order:
Projectile Proximity Specialisation(point blank) -> Endless Munitions -> Gathering Winds -> Mirage Deadeye
